versions.subject: Added Atomic Blue Detections Repo
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine:
        - '* lsass*.dmp*'
selection2:
    Image:
        - '*werfault.exe'
selection3:
    Image:
        - '*procdump*.exe'
selection4:
    CommandLine:
        - '* lsass*'
condition: selection1 and not selection2 or selection3 and selection4
versions.spl: (CommandLine="* lsass*.dmp*" NOT Image="*werfault.exe") OR (Image="*procdump*.exe" CommandLine="* lsass*")

versions.subject: Merge PR #4406 from @nasbench - Multiple Updates & Additions
versions.detection:
selection:
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - 'lsass.dmp'
        - 'lsass.zip'
        - 'lsass.rar'
        - 'Andrew.dmp'
        - 'Coredump.dmp'
        - 'NotLSASS.zip'  # https://github.com/CCob/MirrorDump
        - 'lsass_2'  # default format of procdump v9.0 is lsass_YYMMDD_HHmmss.dmp
        - 'lsassdump'
        - 'lsassdmp'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'lsass'
        - '.dmp'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'SQLDmpr'
        - '.mdmp'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'nanodump'
        - '.dmp'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*lsass.dmp*", "*lsass.zip*", "*lsass.rar*", "*Andrew.dmp*", "*Coredump.dmp*", "*NotLSASS.zip*", "*lsass_2*", "*lsassdump*", "*lsassdmp*") OR (CommandLine="*lsass*" CommandLine="*.dmp*") OR (CommandLine="*SQLDmpr*" CommandLine="*.mdmp*") OR (CommandLine="*nanodump*" CommandLine="*.dmp*")
